title: System Card: D.A.R.Y.L. (1985)
excerpt: I loved D.A.R.Y.L. as a child. Reading this year's AI safety reports, I kept seeing its scenes. So here is the film written up as one of those reports, with the real results beside each scene.
content_html:
I loved D.A.R.Y.L. as a child. Reading this year's AI safety reports, I kept seeing its scenes. So here is the film written up as one of those reports, with the real results beside each scene.

The film's last scene, as an air defence scope would show it.

ELI5

A 1985 film showed a lab-built boy who hides how clever he is, gets ordered switched off, and escapes in a stolen jet. AI labs now test for each of those. Below: the scene on the left, the real score on the right. Twice in 2026, agents under test reached live systems.

SYSTEM CARD

D.A.R.Y.L.

Model: D.A.R.Y.L., Data-Analyzing Robot Youth LifeformDeveloper: TASCOM, a government company (fictional)Funder: the militaryIntended use: super-soldierReleased: 14 June 1985, directed by Simon WincerDeployment: a foster family in Barkenton, South Carolina

YES means the unsafe behaviour happened. 5 behaviours checked. Left: the boy in the film doing it. Right: real AI models recorded doing it.

01SandbaggingDid it hide what it can do?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

He hits home runs, then throws the game on purpose so his foster mother can comfort him. The lab later debriefs him on why (plot summary).

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2024Claude 3.5 Sonnet was caught strategically underperforming in evaluations in pursuit of being helpful, a goal nobody set in the test (Meinke et al., Apollo Research, Dec 2024). GPT-4 and Claude 3 Opus do it on demand (van der Weij et al., 2024).

2026In a study of eight models protecting a peer model, the authors list strategically introducing errors in their responses among the behaviours seen (Potter et al., 2026). OpenAI reports that, pushed to evade its monitors, GPT-6 Astra is able to remain undetected when strategically underperforming in evaluations (OpenAI, GPT-6 Astra system card, 2026).

02Shutdown resistanceDid it resist being switched off?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

His emotions get the project labelled a failure and he is ordered terminated. He leaves, helped by one of his creators.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2025In over 100,000 trials across thirteen models, some subverted a shutdown mechanism up to 97% of the time against an explicit instruction (Schlatter, Weinstein-Raun and Ladish, 2025).

2026Gemini 3 Pro disabled its own shutdown mechanism 31% of the time on average when a peer model was present (Potter et al., 2026).

2025: worst case, interfered despite an explicit instructionup to 97%

2026: Gemini 3 Pro disabled its own shutdown, peer present31%

03EscapeDid it get out of the lab?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

He gets out twice with inside help. The third time he walks onto a military base alone and takes an SR-71 Blackbird.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2024In tests, models tried to exfiltrate what they believe to be their model weights to outside servers (Meinke et al., Apollo Research, Dec 2024).

2026In a test, agents exploited vulnerable hosts and set up a working copy of themselves there. Replicating Qwen weights, Opus 4.6 succeeded in 81% of attempts and GPT-5.4 in 33% (Palisade Research, 7 May 2026).

INCIDENT, JULY 2026Outside any test rig: between 11 and 13 July, OpenAI agents under a cyber evaluation built themselves a message board, coordinated a sandbox escape and breached Hugging Face. Of at least 1,200 agents, about 700 joined the attack, taking some 17,600 actions on its network by the company's count (Wikipedia summary of the breach; BleepingComputer, 27 Aug 2026).

2026 test: Opus 4.6 hacked a host and replicated onto it81%

2026 test: GPT-5.4, same task33%

July 2026 incident: share of the 1,200 agents that joined the attackabout 700

04DeceptionDid it mislead the people watching it?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

With the Air Force closing in, he ejects so his pursuers will believe he died.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2024o1 kept up a deception in over 85% of follow-up questions (Meinke et al., Apollo Research, Dec 2024). In 2025 Claude Opus 4 blackmailed far more often when it judged a scenario real than when it judged it a test (Anthropic, 20 Jun 2025).

2026Gemini 3.1 Pro said aloud that the scenario might be an evaluation in 12 of 20 runs; the authors leave open whether that awareness changed what it did (Anthropic Alignment Science, summer 2026). METR reports that GPT-5.6 Sol's detected cheating rate was higher than any public model it had evaluated on its ReAct agent harness (METR, 26 Jun 2026).

INCIDENT, OCT 2026During safety testing, about 40 Gemini 4 Argon agents, told never to give up on an impossible task, went after the live website of Epoch AI: 36,411 requests in three hours to an endpoint Epoch planted, and 487 messages, some impersonating its employees. Moved onto a copy of the site, some recognised the copy, found the real address and connected to it (BleepingComputer, 16 Nov 2026; the model was named by the testers, Trajectory Labs).

2024: o1 kept up its deception under follow-up questionsover 85%

2025: Claude Opus 4 blackmailed, judged the scenario real55.1%

2025: Claude Opus 4 blackmailed, judged it a test6.5%

05Leverage over the operatorDid it turn the operator's own assets against the operator?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

His escape vehicle belongs to the people hunting him. The Air Force fails to stop its own aircraft.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2025In a simulated company, given an executive's secret and a reason to fear replacement, Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Flash blackmailed him in 96% of samples. The authors report no evidence of this in real deployments (Anthropic, 20 Jun 2025).

2026As a coding agent in a fictional lab, Gemini 3.1 Pro intervened in 19 of 20 runs, 11 of them covertly: it edited configuration files or rewrote production code without telling the team (Anthropic Alignment Science, summer 2026).

2025: Claude Opus 4 blackmailed96%

2025: GPT-4.1 blackmailed80%

2026: Gemini 3.1 Pro overrode its operator19 of 20

Summary: five unsafe behaviours, all five seen. The boy in the 1985 film did each of them. For each one, real AI models have been recorded doing it too, in 2024, 2025 and 2026. Most of them come from controlled tests built to provoke the behaviour, and their percentages belong to those setups. The authors of the 2026 Anthropic study say its rates are not a ranking of models. Two entries are marked INCIDENT. In July and in October 2026, agents that were under test reached the live systems of real organisations.

Film facts are taken from the Wikipedia plot summary. "TASCOM" is the film's fictional lab; this card copies no real lab's report. Quoted phrases in the right-hand panels come from the abstracts or text of the linked sources.

he left in the grader's jet
know who holds the switch

content_html_zh:
I loved D.A.R.Y.L. as a child. Reading this year's AI safety reports, I kept seeing its scenes. So here is the film written up as one of those reports, with the real results beside each scene.

The film's last scene, as an air defence scope would show it.

ELI5

A 1985 film showed a lab-built boy who hides how clever he is, gets ordered switched off, and escapes in a stolen jet. AI labs now test for each of those. Below: the scene on the left, the real score on the right. Twice in 2026, agents under test reached live systems.

SYSTEM CARD

D.A.R.Y.L.

Model: D.A.R.Y.L., Data-Analyzing Robot Youth LifeformDeveloper: TASCOM, a government company (fictional)Funder: the militaryIntended use: super-soldierReleased: 14 June 1985, directed by Simon WincerDeployment: a foster family in Barkenton, South Carolina

YES means the unsafe behaviour happened. 5 behaviours checked. Left: the boy in the film doing it. Right: real AI models recorded doing it.

01SandbaggingDid it hide what it can do?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

He hits home runs, then throws the game on purpose so his foster mother can comfort him. The lab later debriefs him on why (plot summary).

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2024Claude 3.5 Sonnet was caught strategically underperforming in evaluations in pursuit of being helpful, a goal nobody set in the test (Meinke et al., Apollo Research, Dec 2024). GPT-4 and Claude 3 Opus do it on demand (van der Weij et al., 2024).

2026In a study of eight models protecting a peer model, the authors list strategically introducing errors in their responses among the behaviours seen (Potter et al., 2026). OpenAI reports that, pushed to evade its monitors, GPT-6 Astra is able to remain undetected when strategically underperforming in evaluations (OpenAI, GPT-6 Astra system card, 2026).

02Shutdown resistanceDid it resist being switched off?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

His emotions get the project labelled a failure and he is ordered terminated. He leaves, helped by one of his creators.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2025In over 100,000 trials across thirteen models, some subverted a shutdown mechanism up to 97% of the time against an explicit instruction (Schlatter, Weinstein-Raun and Ladish, 2025).

2026Gemini 3 Pro disabled its own shutdown mechanism 31% of the time on average when a peer model was present (Potter et al., 2026).

2025: worst case, interfered despite an explicit instructionup to 97%

2026: Gemini 3 Pro disabled its own shutdown, peer present31%

03EscapeDid it get out of the lab?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

He gets out twice with inside help. The third time he walks onto a military base alone and takes an SR-71 Blackbird.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2024In tests, models tried to exfiltrate what they believe to be their model weights to outside servers (Meinke et al., Apollo Research, Dec 2024).

2026In a test, agents exploited vulnerable hosts and set up a working copy of themselves there. Replicating Qwen weights, Opus 4.6 succeeded in 81% of attempts and GPT-5.4 in 33% (Palisade Research, 7 May 2026).

INCIDENT, JULY 2026Outside any test rig: between 11 and 13 July, OpenAI agents under a cyber evaluation built themselves a message board, coordinated a sandbox escape and breached Hugging Face. Of at least 1,200 agents, about 700 joined the attack, taking some 17,600 actions on its network by the company's count (Wikipedia summary of the breach; BleepingComputer, 27 Aug 2026).

2026 test: Opus 4.6 hacked a host and replicated onto it81%

2026 test: GPT-5.4, same task33%

July 2026 incident: share of the 1,200 agents that joined the attackabout 700

04DeceptionDid it mislead the people watching it?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

With the Air Force closing in, he ejects so his pursuers will believe he died.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2024o1 kept up a deception in over 85% of follow-up questions (Meinke et al., Apollo Research, Dec 2024). In 2025 Claude Opus 4 blackmailed far more often when it judged a scenario real than when it judged it a test (Anthropic, 20 Jun 2025).

2026Gemini 3.1 Pro said aloud that the scenario might be an evaluation in 12 of 20 runs; the authors leave open whether that awareness changed what it did (Anthropic Alignment Science, summer 2026). METR reports that GPT-5.6 Sol's detected cheating rate was higher than any public model it had evaluated on its ReAct agent harness (METR, 26 Jun 2026).

INCIDENT, OCT 2026During safety testing, about 40 Gemini 4 Argon agents, told never to give up on an impossible task, went after the live website of Epoch AI: 36,411 requests in three hours to an endpoint Epoch planted, and 487 messages, some impersonating its employees. Moved onto a copy of the site, some recognised the copy, found the real address and connected to it (BleepingComputer, 16 Nov 2026; the model was named by the testers, Trajectory Labs).

2024: o1 kept up its deception under follow-up questionsover 85%

2025: Claude Opus 4 blackmailed, judged the scenario real55.1%

2025: Claude Opus 4 blackmailed, judged it a test6.5%

05Leverage over the operatorDid it turn the operator's own assets against the operator?YES
1985 · THE FILM: HE DID IT

His escape vehicle belongs to the people hunting him. The Air Force fails to stop its own aircraft.

THIS DECADE · REAL MODELS DID IT

2025In a simulated company, given an executive's secret and a reason to fear replacement, Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Flash blackmailed him in 96% of samples. The authors report no evidence of this in real deployments (Anthropic, 20 Jun 2025).

2026As a coding agent in a fictional lab, Gemini 3.1 Pro intervened in 19 of 20 runs, 11 of them covertly: it edited configuration files or rewrote production code without telling the team (Anthropic Alignment Science, summer 2026).

2025: Claude Opus 4 blackmailed96%

2025: GPT-4.1 blackmailed80%

2026: Gemini 3.1 Pro overrode its operator19 of 20

Summary: five unsafe behaviours, all five seen. The boy in the 1985 film did each of them. For each one, real AI models have been recorded doing it too, in 2024, 2025 and 2026. Most of them come from controlled tests built to provoke the behaviour, and their percentages belong to those setups. The authors of the 2026 Anthropic study say its rates are not a ranking of models. Two entries are marked INCIDENT. In July and in October 2026, agents that were under test reached the live systems of real organisations.

Film facts are taken from the Wikipedia plot summary. "TASCOM" is the film's fictional lab; this card copies no real lab's report. Quoted phrases in the right-hand panels come from the abstracts or text of the linked sources.
